payload.name: Find competing interests for delayed activity
payload.description: When asked why a person sometimes delays, skips, or puts off a regular activity, also search for that person's other hobbies, interests, and preferred activities to explain the behavior.
content: Before answering why someone sometimes delays or omits a recurring activity, run an additional semantic or keyword search for that person's other hobbies, interests, and preferred activities (e.g., query '<person> hobbies and interests').

If the retrieved memories only describe the activity itself or direct mentions of delay, treat evidence as insufficient and expand the search to competing interests; a strong competing interest can explain the delay even if it never mentions the delayed activity.

solves: When a question asks why someone sometimes delays, skips, or puts off a recurring activity, the runtime searches only for direct delay statements and misses competing hobbies that explain the behavior. Apply when seeking reasons for intermittent non-participation by any person; do not apply to external obstacles, scheduling conflicts, or intrinsic activity drawbacks.
